description: Overlong GUID in a blob id overflows a buffer An authenticated JMAP user could construct a blob id containing an overlong GUID and overflow a fixed-size buffer when the server decoded it.
A flaw was found in the flac command-line encoder.

Changing mailbox permissions gated by wrong permissions Through the nonstandard mailbox sharing feature of JMAP for Mail, an authenticated JMAP user with whom a mailbox had been shared could update the permissions on that mailbox, including granting themselves or others further access.
A flaw was found in PipeWire's PulseAudio compatibility server.

An authenticated user with mayWriteOwn access on another user's calendar could patch owner-controlled fields (title, timing, location, etc.) on any event in that calendar, or destroy that event, and not only the events that the sharee organized.
Integer overflow in uriparser ComposeQueryEngine, fixed in uriparser 1.0.3 (bundled in PHP 8.5.13 and 8.6.0)
A flaw was found in flac.
Bound imuxsock PRI digit accumulation to the three digits accepted by its syntax check.
